review.reviewer: independent PH-288 bank-account-balance reviewer (fresh context, read-only)
findings: BLOCKER 1 - period ledger mismatch is a false positive: `_account_bundle` computes `ledger_in/out` with `cash_book_totals(..., through=end)` (lifetime through the period end) but computes `bridge_in/bridge_out` only from the period window, then `_account_issues` compares `ledger_net` with `bridge_in - bridge_out`. As soon as there is prior-period history (the period test creates a prior 7000 receipt and a current 3000 receipt), the clean period snapshot reports `ledger_net_mismatch`; the period test only asserts opening/closing and misses the issue. Fix: compute the ledger movement for the same window (or compare the cumulative ledger net with opening + window movement) and assert issues=[] for a clean period with opening history.

BLOCKER 2 - refunds/returns/internal-transfer totals ignore the window/as_of: `refunds`/`returns` filter only `refund_date/return_date__lte=end` with no `start`, and `InternalTransfer` rows are queried with no date bounds at all, so period snapshots include prior-period refunds/returns and as_of snapshots can include future-dated transfers; the account projections/summary therefore mix lifetime and window totals. Fix: bound refunds/returns/transfers to the same [start, day] window (or explicitly document cumulative semantics and keep period/window fields separate), and add period/as_of regressions with prior and future facts.

PASSED CHECKS: read-only purity (no write/audit/receipt/migration/balance table; fact counts unchanged), no Offset table read and offset_implemented=false/offset_cents=0, append-only INSERT counterexamples, closing=opening+posted_net derived from posted cash, opening prior-to-period, per-account ledger/bridge amounts, 200-account cap, issue codes for no facts/unclassified/ledger mismatch/cross-org/refund/return/transfer same-account/amount/negative/closed-period-future, owner/finance/auditor read, pm/member denial (disclosed no project attribution), both history_read routes GET-readable after module disable, no verify_integrity change, 13 files all inside PH-288 allowed_paths; task in_review, manifest=PH-288. deviations: PM access: the spec says pm may read only the bank summary of projects they manage, but FundingAccount/CashTransaction/Refund/BankReturn/InternalTransfer carry no project attribution, so a project-scoped pm summary cannot be derived without exposing company-wide bank data. This slice denies pm (403) together with member and discloses the spec/runtime mismatch for a future contract (same precedent as PH-279).
Offset: PH-241 is in_review and not a dependency; the snapshot never reads the Offset table, reports offset_cents=0 and offset_implemented=false, and invents no offset fact.

Balance semantics: closing_balance_cents = opening + posted_in - posted_out over posted cash facts, so actual refund/return and internal-transfer cash legs are included in the balance (they are real posted cash). The classification/ledger cash-book totals are computed over the SAME period window as posted cash (occurred_on between period start and as_of) and compared with the non-derived (bridgeable) posted in/out, so a clean period with prior history no longer raises a false ledger_net_mismatch and the expected closing-vs-ledger difference caused by derived refund/return cash is not reported.

future_fact_after_closed_period uses AccountingPeriod.status='posted' plus closed_through as the closed-period signal; it reports posted cash facts dated after closed_through for the requested period.
The read path writes no generic audit (optional in the spec) and no receipt/session state, keeping the snapshot side-effect free; no verify_integrity assertion is changed or added.

Counterexamples are append-only compatible: extra LedgerPosting rows are INSERTed, never UPDATE/DELETE, so SQLite and PostgreSQL append-only triggers behave identically; assertions check derived balance/issue semantics rather than raw input values.

Single worker owns the whole write set (cash bank-balance service/funding views/template/domain metadata, delivery urls, two test files, governance); no parallel slice writes these files; independent review is pending.

Reviewer round-1 fixes: (1) ledger_in/out now use the same [period start, as_of] window instead of cumulative-through-end, eliminating false ledger_net_mismatch for clean periods with opening history (regression added); (2) refunds/returns are filtered to [start, day] and internal transfers to transfer_date in [start, day], so a period snapshot excludes prior refunds and an as_of snapshot excludes future transfers (prior-refund and future-transfer regressions added); summary internal_transfer_count now counts distinct transfer pairs in the window.
Read-only counterexamples stay append-only compatible: extra LedgerPosting rows and the future/prior transfer fixture rows are INSERTed, never UPDATE/DELETE; no historical row is mutated.
